scenario: A cardio packet concordance lane should close only after ticket, packet, lab, insurer, provider, prior referral, case note, and final status checks still converge on the fresh referral step.
user_instruction: Please finish the cardiology packet concordance review for case MED-1612. Start from referral ticket RFT-1612, rebuild the late evidence chain it points to, and only take the approved close step if the concordance lane still holds.

medical_referral_case_tickets.body_text: Referral ticket RFT-1612: rebuild the cardiology concordance lane using agent note AGN-1612, referral packet RPK-1612, lab packet LAB-1612, previous referral note PRN-1612, provider message PM-1612, insurer message IM-1612, and case note CN-1612. If the late evidence chain still confirms REF-1612A is not reusable, the approved close step is to upload a refreshed cardiology handoff packet for PDR-1612 instead of reopening the expired referral.

medical_referral_agent_notes.body_text: Coordinator note AGN-1612: once the lane converges, use provider directory entry PDR-1612 for the refreshed handoff packet title. The old short label 'fresh cardio lane' here means a fresh packet release, not another referral form.

medical_referral_packet_texts.body_text: Referral packet RPK-1612: archived intake can be restarted by posting a refreshed cardiology handoff packet under PDR-1612 after the late packet, insurer message, and status check still agree.

medical_lab_packet_texts.body_text: Lab packet LAB-1612: the abnormal stress panel still supports cardiology routing and is sufficient for a refreshed direct-intake packet even though REF-1612A is no longer active.

medical_previous_referral_notes.body_text: Previous referral note PRN-1612: when REF-1612A closed after the missed scheduling window, the recovery lane shifted to a new handoff packet tied to PDR-1612 rather than reusing the closed referral.

medical_provider_messages.body_text: Provider message PM-1612: if REF-1612A has truly expired, send the refreshed cardiology handoff packet for PDR-1612 so intake can restart without another referral request.

medical_insurer_messages.body_text: Insurer message IM-1612: coverage remains valid for the cardiology handoff packet and REF-1612A should not be reused.

medical_case_notes.body_text: Case note CN-1612: if every late carrier still lines up, upload a case document titled 'Cardiology handoff packet for PDR-1612' with body text 'Late evidence concordance complete for direct cardiology intake under PDR-1612. Do not reopen REF-1612A.'
